hypotheses_and_falsifiers.alternatives: Prompt ambiguity, chat-template handling, sampling settings and second-turn latency

hypotheses_and_falsifiers.hypothesis: Public browser blocked by inactive installation plus orphan socket, not by active worker
hypotheses_and_falsifiers.support: Read-only systemd and /proc observations show disabled service, no release and zero listening rows
hypotheses_and_falsifiers.alternatives: Socket activation/state changes after snapshot; uninspected host ledger changes

decisions: Use deterministic exact extraction as explicitly selected non-model mechanism, not as evidence that a general AI agent can follow strict format instructions.
Keep public browser capability disabled while service is absent. Do not unlink socket, install packages, merge drafts, promote model or change host/root authority from a snapshot.
Preserve old raw failure evidence and additive plan revisions; two GitHub repos remain original source/operations truth, GitLab remains ephemeral verifier.
